title: Change record predicate
description: The predicate of the agent change record: an in-toto Statement v1 (`_type` https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1) whose subject is the head commit (`git+<repo>@<sha>`, digest `gitCommit`) and whose `predicateType` is this schema's URL on the aidd repository. `aidd gate --record` writes it on every decision, `aidd verify` checks it, and the gate workflow may sign it with actions/attest. A draft: `predicate_version` 0.1 may still change before it is declared stable.

predicate_version.description: The version of this predicate's shape; 0.x is a draft.

loop_version.description: The loop contract's version the change ran under.

tenant.description: The tenant the repository's config names, or null: whose Approvers counted.

repo.description: The repository as the adapter names it (`owner/name` on GitHub, the project path on GitLab).

platform.description: github, gitlab, local, or another adapter.

trusted.description: Whether the platform supplied the facts (CI). A record from a local, untrusted context is never evidence.

id.description: The PR/MR number, or locally the head ref.

change.description: The change the decision is for.

profile.description: The profile in force; null when the gate could not read a config.

route.description: The route applied, after the gate's own assessment; null when the gate stopped before it.

lane.description: The lane the route runs in.

required_route.description: The minimum route the real diff requires.

base_sha.description: The base commit the diff and the red runs were measured against.

head_sha.description: The head commit judged: the statement's subject.

merge_group_sha.description: For a merge-queue entry: the merge-group commit the tests ran on.

config_sha256.description: Digest of the base-branch config with its org preset and parents: the policy in force.

path.description: The Spec's path in the repository, or null.

hash.description: The Spec approval hash: the Spec, its test files, and its design files.

approval_required.description: Whether the route needed Spec approval under the profile.

approvals.description: Each counted Spec approval of that hash: who, when, and the commit it named.

approved_before_implementation.description: Whether an approval named a commit holding only the Spec and its frozen files.

spec.description: The Spec the change implements, or null for a change without one.

approvals.description: Each counted Merge approval of the head commit.

specialists.description: Per required specialist pool, who approved the head.

separation_of_duties.description: Whether approvals had to come from outside the authors, or solo waived it.

merge_approval.description: Merge approval: the authorization of what was built.

runner.description: The CI run that produced the evidence (`ci`, `run_id`, `url`).

source.description: Where the command came from: config, spec, or change_request.

command.description: The command, as an argument list.

green_exit.description: The exit code on the head commit.

red_exit.description: The exit code on the base commit, when the command ran there (red-then-green).

red_status.description: The status on the base commit, or null when the command did not run there.

tests.description: Each required test command: red on base and green on head, as exit codes from the runner.

status_checks.description: Existing CI check runs counted as evidence, with their state on the head.

evidence.description: The test evidence the decision rests on.

result.description: Whether every changed path was inside the declared scope.

declared.description: The paths and globs the change declared as its scope.

changed_files.description: How many files the diff changes.

changed_lines.description: Lines added and deleted that the change budget counts.

authors.description: Everyone accountable for the change; none of them may approve it outside solo.

agent_accounts.description: The config's `identities.bots`: accounts that act as agents and never approve.

provenance.description: Which agents wrote the change, and who authored it.

findings.description: Every finding as `level code`, sorted: what fired and why.
